# **inferCSN**

## **Introduction**

[inferCSN](https://mengxu98.github.io/inferCSN/) is an R package for
**infer**ring **C**ell-**S**pecific gene regulatory **N**etwork from
single-cell RNA data.

![inferCSN+ workflow
diagram](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mengxu98/figures/main/inferCSN/inferCSN.svg#gh-light-mode-only)

![inferCSN+ workflow
diagram](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mengxu98/figures/main/inferCSN/inferCSN-dark.svg#gh-dark-mode-only)

## **Installation**

You can install the released version from
[CRAN](https://github.com/cran) use:

``` r

install.packages("inferCSN")
# or
if (!require("pak", quietly = TRUE)) {
  install.packages("pak")
}
pak::pak("inferCSN")
```

You can install the development version from
[GitHub](https://github.com/mengxu98/inferCSN) use
[pak](https://github.com/r-lib/pak):

``` r

if (!require("pak", quietly = TRUE)) {
  install.packages("pak")
}
pak::pak("mengxu98/inferCSN")
```

## **Usage**

### **Examples**

``` r

library(inferCSN)
data(example_matrix)

network <- inferCSN(
  example_matrix
)
```

More functions and usages about
[inferCSN](https://mengxu98.github.io/inferCSN/)? Please reference
[here](https://mengxu98.github.io/inferCSN/reference/index.html).

## **Citation**

If you use [inferCSN](https://github.com/mengxu98/inferCSN) in your
work, please cite it reference
[here](https://mengxu98.github.io/inferCSN/authors.html#citation).

# Package index

### Inferring cell-specific gene regulatory network

- [`inferCSN-package`](https://mengxu98.github.io/inferCSN/reference/inferCSN-package.md)
  : Inferring Cell-Specific Gene Regulatory Network
- [`infercsn_logo()`](https://mengxu98.github.io/inferCSN/reference/inferCSN_logo.md)
  : The logo of inferCSN
- [`inferCSN()`](https://mengxu98.github.io/inferCSN/reference/inferCSN.md)
  : inferring cell-type specific gene regulatory network

### Sparse regression model

- [`single_network()`](https://mengxu98.github.io/inferCSN/reference/single_network.md)
  : Construct network for single target gene
- [`fit_greedy_l0()`](https://mengxu98.github.io/inferCSN/reference/fit_greedy_l0.md)
  : Fit greedy L0 regression
- [`fit_greedy_l0_batch()`](https://mengxu98.github.io/inferCSN/reference/fit_greedy_l0_batch.md)
  : Fit batched greedy L0 regressions

### Utils functions

- [`filter_sort_matrix()`](https://mengxu98.github.io/inferCSN/reference/filter_sort_matrix.md)
  : Filter and sort a network matrix
- [`network_format()`](https://mengxu98.github.io/inferCSN/reference/network_format.md)
  : Format a network table
- [`print(`*`<infercsn_logo>`*`)`](https://mengxu98.github.io/inferCSN/reference/print.inferCSN_logo.md)
  : Print logo

### Example data

- [`example_matrix`](https://mengxu98.github.io/inferCSN/reference/example_matrix.md)
  : Example matrix data
- [`example_meta_data`](https://mengxu98.github.io/inferCSN/reference/example_meta_data.md)
  : Example meta data
- [`example_ground_truth`](https://mengxu98.github.io/inferCSN/reference/example_ground_truth.md)
  : Example ground truth data
